newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones fell 47.33 points to 6,877.74. PLDT's ADR dipped $1 to $58.
* The peso closed higher at 26.331 to the dollar vs 26.333.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index dropped 18.66 points to 3,315.28.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.53125 percent.
